title: Hurghada island boat trip distances by island 2026
body_markdown:
The distance from Hurghada to Giftun Island is about 8 nautical miles (roughly 15 km) from Hurghada Marina, a 25-30 minute boat ride at standard tour-boat cruising speed. That number changes fast once you look at the rest of Hurghada's island map for 2026 — some stops are a short hop, others eat half your day just getting there and back.


**TL;DR**

- Distance from Hurghada to Giftun Island is about 8 nautical miles, a 25-30 minute boat ride in 2026.
- Orange Bay is the farthest common stop at roughly 20 nautical miles, a 90-120 minute crossing.
- Mahmya Island runs 45-60 minutes; Paradise Island and Small Giftun sit closer at 30-40 minutes.
- Distance decides how much beach time you actually get — pick by minutes on the water, not just the island's name.




## Why this matters

Every island boat trip out of Hurghada gets sold as a full day out, but the boat ride itself eats a real chunk of that day depending on which island is on the itinerary. A trip to [Giftun Island](https://dailyredsea.byryze.com/giftun-island-snorkeling-trip-for-beginners) leaves you with far more time in the water than a trip to Orange Bay, purely because of the distance covered getting there.

Knowing the actual nautical miles and minutes on the water before you book means you're not surprised when "one boat trip" turns into a three-hour round-trip crossing. It also explains why two boats leaving the same marina at the same hour can come back at completely different times.

## Hurghada island distances by island, 2026 benchmarks

All distances below are measured from Hurghada Marina, the departure point for the large majority of island boat trips, and calculated using standard tour-boat cruising speeds of 15-18 knots. Times are one-way; double them for a round trip, then add anchor time at the island itself.

| Island | Distance from Hurghada Marina | One-way boat time | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| **All islands (average)** | ~11 nautical miles | ~40-50 min | Yardstick for comparison |
| Giftun Island (Big Giftun) | ~8 nautical miles (15 km) | 25-30 min | Half-day snorkeling |
| Small Giftun | ~9 nautical miles (17 km) | 30-35 min | Quieter reef, fewer boats |
| Paradise Island (Utopia) | ~9 nautical miles (16 km) | 30-40 min | Shallow snorkeling, families |
| Abu Minqar Island | ~10 nautical miles (18 km) | 35-45 min | Reef snorkeling day trips |
| Mahmya Island | ~12 nautical miles (22 km) | 45-60 min | Beach day, sun loungers |
| Orange Bay (Satayeh) | ~20 nautical miles (37 km) | 90-120 min | Full-day snorkeling trips |

**Giftun Island is the closest common stop at roughly 8 nautical miles; Orange Bay trails the whole list at roughly 20 nautical miles**, more than double the crossing. Mahmya Island sits in the middle of the pack, which is why it's marketed as a "relaxed beach day" rather than a snorkeling-heavy trip — the extra 15-20 minutes each way gets traded for calmer water and a longer sand strip.


![Diagram of Hurghada Marina as a hub with island stops at varying distances](https://gwvckixiegkllthleuyt.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/workspace-article-images-public/12c06b2e-bdfe-49db-b800-1273b65ac969/body-333421104b6df528351ad61e8d437f5d.jpg)

*Giftun Island and Paradise Island sit closest to the marina; Orange Bay is the longest crossing.*


### Methodology and one limitation

These figures come from marina-to-island GPS distances converted at typical Red Sea day-boat cruising speeds of 15-18 knots, which is how most Hurghada operators plan trip timing for 2026 departures. The one thing this table can't tell you: actual crossing time swings with sea state — a choppy Meltemi-wind afternoon can add 15-20 minutes to any of these routes, especially the longer Orange Bay run.

## How to use these benchmarks

- **Picking a half-day trip?** Stick to Giftun Island, Small Giftun, or Paradise Island — all under 40 minutes each way, leaving 3+ hours in the water.
- **Booking with kids or anyone prone to seasickness?** Shorter crossings matter more than the island's reputation; Giftun Island's 25-30 minute ride beats Orange Bay's 90-120 minute one by a wide margin. [How to avoid seasickness on Hurghada boat trips](https://dailyredsea.byryze.com/how-to-avoid-seasickness-on-hurghada-boat-trips) covers the practical fixes.
- **Want maximum snorkeling time over transit time?** [Mahmya Island](https://dailyredsea.byryze.com/mahmya-island-boat-trip-for-day-trippers) and Giftun Island both keep the ratio in your favor.
- **Only have one full day and want the farthest, least-crowded reef?** [Orange Bay](https://dailyredsea.byryze.com/best-orange-bay-day-trips-from-hurghada) is worth the longer ride, but plan the whole day around it — it's not a trip you tack onto a half-day schedule.

## One last thing

The Giftun Islands sit inside a protected marine national park, which is why boats moor at fixed points instead of anchoring wherever the captain likes — it's also part of why the reef around Giftun Island has held up better than shoreline reefs closer to the hotel strip. If reef condition matters more to you than beach chairs, that 25-30 minute ride to Giftun Island is buying you the better underwater view, not just the shorter trip.

## FAQ


**What is the distance from Hurghada to Giftun Island?**

The distance from Hurghada to Giftun Island is about 8 nautical miles (roughly 15 km) from Hurghada Marina. Most tour boats cover that in 25-30 minutes one-way at standard cruising speed.

**How far is Orange Bay from Hurghada?**

Orange Bay sits roughly 20 nautical miles (about 37 km) from Hurghada Marina, the farthest common island stop on the route. Expect 90-120 minutes each way by boat.

**How long is the boat ride to Mahmya Island?**

The boat ride to Mahmya Island runs 45-60 minutes one-way, covering roughly 12 nautical miles from Hurghada Marina. It's a longer ride than Giftun Island but shorter than Orange Bay.

**Which Hurghada island is closest to the marina?**

Giftun Island is the closest common stop at about 8 nautical miles, followed closely by Small Giftun and Paradise Island around 9 nautical miles.

**Is Small Giftun the same as Giftun Island?**

No. Small Giftun and Big Giftun (usually just called Giftun Island) are two separate islands in the same archipelago, roughly 1 nautical mile apart, both reached from Hurghada Marina.

**Do all Hurghada island boat trips leave from the same place?**

Most depart from Hurghada Marina, which is why the distances above are measured from that point. A few private charters use other launch points closer to specific resort areas.

**Does rough sea change the travel time to the islands?**

Yes. Choppy conditions, common during Meltemi wind spells, can add 15-20 minutes to any of these crossings, with the longer Orange Bay route affected the most.

**Which island trip is best for someone prone to seasickness?**

Giftun Island's short 25-30 minute crossing is the easiest ride on this list. Orange Bay's 90-120 minute crossing is the toughest for anyone sensitive to motion.
